# Alphabet Commanders

> A free English sentence-building site for Marathi-speaking children in rural India, built for the US Kids 4 Water Alphabet Commanders program.

Students learn 30 Level 1 English words with Marathi pronunciation, write their own sentences with instant grammar feedback, and take a scored vocabulary test. Practice, test and journal pages require a student account and are not public.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What the Alphabet Commanders program is and how the practice works.
- [Word Bank](/words): All 30 Level 1 English words with Marathi pronunciation, part of speech, meaning and example sentences.
- [Daily Use English Sentences with Marathi Meaning](/sentences/daily-use): Common everyday English sentences — greetings, classroom talk and household chores — with Marathi meaning and pronunciation.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Student and teacher account access.
